legal_ref: No VAT law enacted; GCC Unified VAT Agreement signed but not ratified/implemented domestically
quote: Ministry of Finance tax services list only: "ضريبة الشركات والمؤسسات" (tax on companies and establishments) and "الضريبة التكميلية على مجموعة الكيانات متعددة الجنسيات" (domestic minimum top-up tax on multinational groups) — no VAT or sales tax appears among the taxes administered.
source_title: Ministry of Finance Kuwait – Company tax services page (Wayback Machine copy, 2026; mof.gov.kw refused connections from here)
notes: Kuwait has not introduced VAT or any general sales tax. It signed the GCC Unified VAT Agreement (5% framework) but no domestic VAT law has been passed by the National Assembly; the 2017-era plan to introduce VAT was repeatedly postponed. Taxes in force: corporate income tax on foreign bodies corporate (15%), Zakat and National Labour Support Tax on Kuwaiti listed companies, and the Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax on multinational groups (Decree-Law 157/2024, from 1 Jan 2025). Customs duty (generally 5% under the GCC Common Customs Law) applies on imports.
unverified: No explicit official statement 'Kuwait has not applied VAT' was retrievable: mof.gov.kw refused connections; position inferred from the absence of VAT among MOF-administered taxes and from no VAT law existing. Press reports (2026) say the 2026-2030 fiscal plan does not include VAT.
